architecture.ui: native SwiftUI/UIKit shell (JavaFX does not run interactively on iOS: no AWT/Swing, no Prism on a no-JIT device)

architecture.execution: org.bluej.ipad.spike interpreter, extended to the BlueJ-intro subset, instruction budgets for cancellation
architecture.compiler: open — ECJ 3.40.0 is EPL-2.0 and cannot ship in the GPLv2+CE app; evaluate the bundled OpenJDK javac
architecture.debugger: interpreter-native breakpoints/step/variables; JDI is impossible for interpreted frames on iOS
